title: MGTitle
description: Sends a title to a player or all players
body:
# MGTitle — Send Titles to Players Easily!

**MGTitle** is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin for Minecraft servers that allows you to send custom title messages to individual players or broadcast them to all online players with a simple command.

Whether you're running events, making announcements, or adding more interaction to your server — MGTitle makes it easy and clean.

---

## 🌟 Features

- 🎯 Send a title to a specific player:  
  `/mgtitle <player> <your message>`

- 🌐 Send a title to **all online players**:  
  `/mgtitle all <your message>`

- ♻️ Reload the plugin configuration without restarting the server:  
  `/mgreload`

- 🖍 Supports color codes using `&` (e.g., `&aHello!` = green "Hello!")

- ⚡ Minimal performance impact — optimized for production servers

- ✅ Works on Paper, Spigot, and other Bukkit-compatible servers
